programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is making the coziest foods imaginable  spiced beef hot dish with bacon jalapeño cornbread  loaded potato skins  for dessert, dreamy tahini fudge pie.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is cooking for a Norwegian dinner celebration on the farm, starting with Lefse hot dogs with fennel slaw and open face salmon and avocado sandwiches  she also makes crispy paprika fries with dill mayo and a stunning Norwegian wreath cake.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh's making cozy dishes to share with her synchronized skating trio  she starts with spiced tomato ABCs, followed by fried beef tacos, cheesy Parmesan broccoli and coffee cookie butter cones for dessert.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh hosts Brunch Club with her friends  she makes blueberry cream cheese scones with yogurt glaze, bacon Hasselback sweet potatoes, pita and greens Benedict with feta cream and caraway bloody Marys with mini Reubens.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh and her husband, Nick, are missing the Big Apple -- especially the food -- so to crush the craving, she whips up pastrami sandwiches with onion rings, hearty chicken kreplach soup and, for dessert, beautiful black and pink cookies.

programs.title: Midnight Misadventures With Mallika Dua
programs.desc: Shalishka bounces back from a breakup by preparing Arancini de Szechuan with actor Vicky Kaushal.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh's dad is in town to play a clarinet concert, and she's making an Asian-inspired lunch of succulent sugar-coated pork buns and crunchy drunken cucumber noodles to fill him up beforehand, plus homemade matcha mochi donuts.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Molly Yeh is having a fry-out on the farm  she makes juicy buttermilk fried chicken, a roasted broccoli and grape salad and colorful Harissa carrots and ranch  almond tarts with a sweet raspberry glaze.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Thanksgiving on the farm  creamy twice-baked potatoes  brussels sprout casserole  sweet and sticky orange marmalade glazed ham  pumpkin pie with whipped cream and cinnamon.

programs.title: Girl Meets Farm
programs.desc: Nick's building their own bowling lane, and they're inviting friends over to play and enjoy Molly's super sloppy joes, crave-worthy sweet potato waffle fry nachos and crunchy snap pea popcorn salad.
